prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were helpful, winning in 6 of 11 tests (+9.3%, +5.6%, +4.3%, +4.4%, +3.1%, and +2.4%), while 5 showed no clear effect.
Sign-in wait info (sign_in wait_info) updates were helpful, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+3.0% and +7.3%), while 1 showed no clear effect.
Home wait info (home wait_info) changes were helpful in 5 of 13 tests (+4.2%, +3.9%, +2.6%, +2.7%, and +1.7%), while 8 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign and sign-in reordering (sign_in reorder) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests each.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Quick Command Simulation Flow: Adds an interactive command practice section on the home intro screen featuring click-to-test actions for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish new_flow experiments have a strong historical win rate (6 of 11 tests won).)
1: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Cloud Sync & Preservation Progress Status Info: Displays a cloud sync status bar and explicit reassurance message on the sign-in screen confirming pet data state verification. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in, while sign_in wait_info updates previously won in 2 of 3 tests (+3.0% and +7.3%).)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay & Rendering Initialization Status Monitor: Adds rendering visual status indicators and layer preparation details to the waiting screen. (why: Users face a median wait of 201s (mean 2336s) at the waiting stage, and support received 3 complaints about pets failing to show up on desktop; home wait_info has won in 5 previous tests.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion System Tray and Visibility Practice Screen: Introduces a new interactive step 'new_tray_controls' right after home_intro where users practice toggling taskbar visibility and hotkeys before completing setup. (why: Multiple support tickets express confusion on hiding or recalling desktop pets, and new interactive finishing screens build on proven finish conversion boosters.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Angle & Lighting Diagnostic Tip: Displays a clear visual hint card on the photo upload screen recommending front-facing photo orientation and light contrast. (why: Custom pet creation fails or looks wrong for several users (3 support tickets), and adoption has the highest drop-off rate (72.3% drop) with 1017s mean wait time.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Audio and Chat Quick Shortcut Tip: Adds a prominent quick-tip banner on the home_intro screen explaining key shortcuts for chatting with and controlling the pet. (why: 3 support emails indicated confusion around how to talk to or control the desktop pet post-onboarding.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Universal Cloud Login Continuity Status Hint: Adds a clear hint banner below sign-in options explaining that signing in secures pet memory and state permanently. (why: 8 support emails involved pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making account continuity reassurance crucial.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Startup Readiness Notification Toggle: Enables a ready notification setting on the home intro screen letting users toggle alerts when their pet finishes booting on desktop. (why: Support receives messages about desktop features misbehaving after setup (4 emails); explicit launch notification setup sets proper user expectations.)

scores.note: Finish step already converts at 95.3%, but interactive finish flows have a strong history of success (6/11 wins, +2.6% avg).
Sign-in loses 14.4% of users and has 8 support complaints; wait_info changes on sign_in have strong historical win rates (+3.5% avg).
Home step conversion is high (95.5%) despite long wait times; home wait_info has moderate success across 13 tests (+1.6% avg).
Adding new screens at finish step historically hurt performance (-1.0% avg across 2 tests) and requires significant code release.
Adoption is the biggest bottleneck in the funnel (72.3% rate); hints consistently provide modest positive gains (+0.9% avg across 6 tests).
Finish step drop-off is minimal; adding a simple hint banner carries low implementation cost with minor expected lift.
8 support complaints point directly to sign-in state confusion; hint updates on sign_in yield mild reliable improvements (+0.6% avg).
Addresses 4 support complaints on post-setup behavior, but evidence for finish notification is limited to 1 test (+1.6%).
